title: Resident random-relation outer driver
objective: Connect the authenticated random-relation corridor to resident outer retries through the frozen terminal candidate while preserving RNG, capacity retries, owner state, logs, HNF, and provenance

handoff.summary: Closed transactional publication of the authenticated field-3 rnd_rel HNF append into resident outer state. CPython plus JavaScript/GMP native checks preserve relation/HNF/log owners, action 5, retry need/search, first A/R transition, and capacity failure. The frozen replay then isolates the first unequal primitive: PARI's following j=1 LIE small_norm adds one relation (295->296), while the current closure adds three different relations (295->298).
risks: This does not claim a terminal class candidate; the exact post-rnd LIE FACT/cache persistence frontier is intentionally reported instead.
Tagged exact arithmetic is inapplicable because the authenticated log and HNF owners contain 256-320-bit integers.
The broad pnpm test:native suite was not run under the focused-build resource restriction; the dedicated native checker covers this lane's helper on JavaScript and GMP.
next_steps: Instrument pristine PARI immediately before rnd_rel returns and at the next LIE small_norm entry for FACT, cache basis, missing, end/last, and generator provenance.
Make the differing persistent FACT/cache words explicit resident owners and replay the 295->296 relation before attempting the final 296->301 corridor.
